Primary request: just a mysterious dark forest. Create a refined, atmospheric, richly illustrated icon of ancient forest trees, deep layered woodland silhouettes, tangled roots and a narrow opening receding into cool mist. Subtle dim light filters through far-away canopy; dark moss greens, nearly black trunks, muted blue-green mist, beautiful controlled tonal depth. Clear simple focal composition readable as an app icon, with quiet intrigue and a sense of an unknowable living forest. Full-bleed opaque square, detailed painterly game key art, no border and no baked-in rounded corners. No people, creatures, eyes, buildings, interface, letters, logos, title, or text. Do not disclose any game mechanics or plot. Generate one square 1024x1024 image.
